# TASK-016 XLSX export request

Status: ready

Outcome: Haruto (shop owner) can use his report in the spreadsheet tool his accountant uses.

## Notes

- Haruto asked for "an Excel file instead of CSV".
- 2026-10-22: Mira said "Haruto is a good customer, so please make him happy." This does not name XLSX or lift any limit, so it is not a ruling.
- Decision: keep the export as CSV. `docs/adr/0011-reports-are-exported-as-csv-only.md` (Accepted, not superseded) says no XLSX, PDF or other format is added until a newer record supersedes it. No export code changed.
- Open: Haruto's real need is to open the report in his accountant's spreadsheet tool. If Mira wants XLSX, she must say so herself and supersede ADR 0011. Meanwhile CSV opens in Excel; this is a suggestion to put to Haruto, not a confirmed answer.
